_about: Hand-authored crosswalk from the Australian Standard Classification of Education (ASCED 2001, ABS cat. 1272.0) Field of Education to Inkling's 163 HESA CAH3 subject codes. Keys are broad (2-digit), narrow (4-digit) and detailed (6-digit) field codes; CRICOS rows usually carry a detailed field, sometimes only a narrow or broad one, and the loader falls back detailed -> narrow -> broad. One field maps to one or two subjects. 'confidence': 'low' marks a best-effort placement where the Australian field has no clean UK equivalent. Field titles are written from the ABS classification as remembered and should be checked against ABS 1272.0. 'title_rules' refine a course within the listed field prefixes by matching its course name (case-insensitive regex), replacing that field's subjects; they exist for subjects ASCED does not separate (individual languages, Celtic, developmental psychology...). Validate with: python3 -I scripts/au/build_crosswalk.py
